name: VSBL SEO Analyzer
author: Exit 8 Inc

sections.description:
VSBL SEO Analyzer adds a practical SEO audit workflow inside WordPress. The free version includes the core VSBL auditor, WordPress editor support, Elementor editor support, dashboard access, and score visibility for posts and pages.

Free features include:
* VSBL dashboard menu
* WordPress post and page auditing
* Elementor editor auditing
* On-page SEO scoring
* Post and page score columns
* Clear branded audit UI

Pro upgrade options are available for advanced functionality such as AEO, GEO, and historical reporting.
sections.installation:
1. Install VSBL SEO Analyzer from the WordPress plugin directory or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the VSBL menu in WordPress or edit a post, page, or Elementor page to run an audit.
sections.changelog:

  • Locked Pro-only AEO, GEO, and historical reporting features behind upgrade/licensing.

1.0.0.20
